# Device Battery Status 1.2.0

Stable release for personal use. Packages are unsigned.

- Add remaining-runtime estimates from fresh timestamped percentage trends in the popup and tray tooltips. Charging, stale readings, connection uncertainty and monitoring gaps reset or exclude the trend. Categories never become invented percentages or runtime estimates.
- Add compact gaming alerts with global/per-device percentage and confident-runtime thresholds, native Low/Critical categories, duration, monitor, snooze, cooldown/recovery and synthetic preview. Sound defaults off. Ordinary click-through, non-activating desktop windows can defer alerts during fullscreen/busy states; real-game compatibility remains unverified.
- Add independent capacity-health calculation, sourced design entry and persistent valid history. Current supported Razer, Logitech and Alienware protocols lack sufficient capacity telemetry and honestly show Capacity measurement unavailable. Percentage, voltage alone and runtime never become capacity health.
- Reduce repeated discovery, failed-device queries, settings copies, diagnostic scans and tray allocations. Coalesce refreshes, preserve independent freshness, handle sleep/resume and retain deliberate manual polling-rate controls.
- Move synthetic fixtures to a separate verification harness and improve ZIP compression. Retain the full desktop runtime, localisation, licences and notices. Bound settings recovery and transient capacity advisories. Existing tray modes, diagnostics, preferences, installation and verified manual updates remain available.

## Verification and failures

Exact source: `d76cd565b6a9ff2e62e51e5092685e2b063984e7`. [Windows build/packages/companion/installer run](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/actions/runs/40306127179), [full-software run](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/actions/runs/40306132491), [verification and failure report](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/blob/main/docs/release-1.2.0-verification.md).

Passed: Windows compilation; 1,116 C# cases each in Debug/Release; 5 parser and 39 automation cases; 18 companion checks per portable flavor; 64 installer lifecycle assertions. No unexpected failures or skipped tests. Compilation has 0 errors and 18 existing warnings (nullable analysis, test-fixture/assertion style and WPF/WinForms DPI guidance), unchanged from the preceding candidate. The intentional installer mutex refusal is a passing negative test.

The companion loads and hashes the actual packaged application assemblies and self-contained runtime; it does not launch the normal apphost/startup/controller, access HID or launch games. Installer tests never start the installed app. The older-version installer fixture uses current application bytes. Physical compatibility, battery accuracy, real-game/input routing, physical DPI/power/PnP/Explorer events, normal startup/idle performance and endurance remain unverified. No lower idle CPU/memory claim is made. This private repository's credential-free updater cannot fetch releases anonymously; use the signed-in browser fallback.
